decisive_items: Dense granulomatous infiltrate in the upper dermis consisting of histiocytes, lymphocytes, foam cells, multinucleated giant cells, eosinophils, and hemorrhage
response.rationale: Clinical systemic involvement with diabetes insipidus and skin lesions plus CD68-positive, CD1a/S-100-negative histiocytic infiltrate with foam cells favors Erdheim-Chester disease over Langerhans cell histiocytosis and Niemann-Pick disease.

rejected.why: Foam cells and CD68 positivity overlap, but Niemann-Pick disease does not explain the systemic endocrine involvement or generalized granulomatous skin eruption.
Multisystem involvement and skin lesions overlap, but negative CD1a and S-100 excludes Langerhans cell histiocytosis.
